# Dosya Help Center

> Official help for Dosya cloud storage, file sharing, apps, integrations, security, automation, and troubleshooting.

- [Help home](https://help.dosya.dev/): Browse every help category.
- [Search](https://help.dosya.dev/search): Search published Dosya guides.
- [Full guide text](https://help.dosya.dev/llms-full.txt): Read the complete text of all 781 published guides.
- [Mobile app help](https://help.dosya.dev/mobile): Browse iPhone and Android backup, file, contact, and playback guides.
- [Dosya website](https://dosya.dev/): Product information, downloads, and company resources.

## File uploads and downloads

- [Canceling an upload safely](https://help.dosya.dev/uploading/cancel-upload): Stop the intended queued or active upload, check the other transfers, and confirm whether a complete file already exists in Files.
- [Choose a direct download or ZIP archive](https://help.dosya.dev/uploading/download-choose-method): Download one cloud file directly, or package folders and selected items as one or more streamed ZIP archives within Dosya's archive limits.
- [Choose the correct workspace and folder before uploading](https://help.dosya.dev/uploading/upload-confirm-workspace): Switch to the intended Dosya workspace, select a writable cloud folder, and verify a completed test upload before transferring important files.
- [Complete your first upload and sharing task](https://help.dosya.dev/uploading/first-upload-and-share): Upload a harmless sample file, confirm its completed cloud copy, create a suitable sharing link, and test the recipient experience before sending it.
- [Download a cloud folder as a ZIP archive](https://help.dosya.dev/uploading/download-folder-archive): Download one Dosya folder with its nested paths intact, recognize protected or empty content, and resolve the exact archive size and file-count limits.
- [Download selected files as ZIP archives](https://help.dosya.dev/uploading/download-selection-archive): Use Download ZIP for a mixed file selection, understand when Dosya creates multiple archives, and recover from size, count or permission errors.
- [Downloading one file or several files](https://help.dosya.dev/uploading/download-files): Download one cloud file directly, or select files and folders to receive one or more streamed ZIP archives with clear size and entry limits.
- [Estimate storage before a large upload](https://help.dosya.dev/uploading/upload-estimate-storage): Total the source bytes, compare them with workspace free space, and account for versions, trash, concurrent uploads, and workspace storage caps.
- [Fix an upload blocked by the destination](https://help.dosya.dev/uploading/upload-destination-locked): Check the destination's lock and role restrictions, then choose a writable folder and restart the affected upload deliberately.
- [Prepare file names before uploading](https://help.dosya.dev/uploading/upload-prepare-file-names): Prepare names for Dosya sanitization, the 255-character limit, extension rules, and same-name versioning before starting a large upload batch.
- [Preserve folder structure during an upload](https://help.dosya.dev/uploading/upload-preserve-folder-structure): Use Select folder or a folder drop, let Dosya rebuild parent folders first, and verify skipped subtrees instead of accepting a flattened upload.
- [Record useful details for an upload failure](https://help.dosya.dev/uploading/upload-record-failure-details): Capture the failed row’s exact error, file name, size, destination, workspace, time, browser state, and retry outcome before clearing the queue.
- [Recover an upload after refreshing the browser](https://help.dosya.dev/uploading/upload-recover-after-refresh): Resume an interrupted browser upload by reselecting the same source file, then verify the completed cloud copy without creating a duplicate.
- [Remove a downloaded file from a shared computer](https://help.dosya.dev/uploading/download-clean-up-local-copy): Delete downloaded files, extracted copies and browser traces from a shared computer while preserving the Dosya cloud original.
- [Resume an upload after a network interruption](https://help.dosya.dev/uploading/upload-resume-after-network): Recover a network-interrupted cloud upload by retrying in the same tab or reselecting its original source after a browser reload.
- [Retry a failed archive download](https://help.dosya.dev/uploading/download-retry-prepared-archive): Rebuild the original Files selection and start a fresh streamed ZIP after an archive fails; Dosya does not keep an expiring prepared job to reopen.
- [Retry one failed upload item](https://help.dosya.dev/uploading/upload-retry-one-item): Retry one failed row while its bytes remain in the tab, or reselect the same name and size after a reload so completed items stay untouched.
- [Run a one-file upload preflight](https://help.dosya.dev/uploading/upload-test-one-file): Send one uniquely named sample to the final folder, wait for Done, then use View file and File details to verify destination, name, and size.
- [Split a large cloud folder download](https://help.dosya.dev/uploading/large-folder-download): Measure a large Dosya folder against the 10,000-file and 5 GiB archive ceilings, split it safely, and recover when only some ZIP downloads start.
- [Start a streaming ZIP download](https://help.dosya.dev/uploading/download-archive-preparation): Start a streamed ZIP from Files, allow the browser time to accept it, and confirm the download begins without starting duplicate archive requests.
- [Troubleshoot a folder archive download](https://help.dosya.dev/uploading/folder-download-troubleshoot): Use the archive tab and exact refusal text to separate empty, locked, oversized, permission, selection-size, and other browser transfer failures.
- [Understanding storage usage and failed quota checks](https://help.dosya.dev/uploading/storage-usage): Read the active workspace’s storage total, account for retained versions and trash, and choose a safe cleanup or capacity action.
- [Understanding upload progress and transfer states](https://help.dosya.dev/uploading/progress-and-states): Read Queued, Uploading, Done, Error, Interrupted and Canceled states, then choose the action that matches the current transfer.
- [Uploading files and folders to Dosya](https://help.dosya.dev/uploading/files-and-folders): Choose a cloud workspace and folder, upload individual files or a complete folder tree, then verify every completed item in Dosya.
- [Uploading large files with available storage](https://help.dosya.dev/uploading/large-files): Check storage and workspace limits, keep a large transfer running, and verify the completed file before removing the original.
- [Verify a downloaded Dosya ZIP archive](https://help.dosya.dev/uploading/verify-downloaded-archive): Confirm a Dosya ZIP finished, compare its paths and file counts with the cloud selection, and identify collision names or missing-object notices before sharing.
- [Verify a downloaded file by name and size](https://help.dosya.dev/uploading/download-verify-file): Compare the downloaded file with Dosya File details by name and displayed size, then open the local copy to confirm the intended item arrived.

## File sharing and file requests

- [Audit a sensitive file delivery](https://help.dosya.dev/sharing/audit-delivery): Check one sensitive share's audience, password, expiry, download policy, recipient verification, event evidence, and final revocation state.
- [Change a file-request destination folder](https://help.dosya.dev/sharing/request-change-destination): Move future file-request uploads to another workspace folder without moving existing files, while checking scope, lock, permission, and visibility rules.
- [Change a sharing-link password](https://help.dosya.dev/sharing/share-change-password): Replace a protected link from the web app for immediate access cutoff, or understand the existing-recipient effect of an in-place API password rotation.
- [Check file-request limits before uploading](https://help.dosya.dev/sharing/request-uploader-check-limits): Check accepted extensions, per-file size, and remaining slots before transfer, then recognize quota or concurrent-uploader refusals correctly.
- [Choose a destination for requested files](https://help.dosya.dev/sharing/request-destination-folder): Choose where requested files land, understand root and per-uploader folders, and verify the destination safely before inviting external uploaders.
- [Choose download access for a sharing link](https://help.dosya.dev/sharing/share-download-control): Choose between normal download access, View only and a download-count limit when creating a Dosya sharing link, then test the recipient result.
- [Close a file request after collecting uploads](https://help.dosya.dev/sharing/request-close-collection): Review received and pending submissions, revoke the file-request upload link, and verify that new uploads stop while previously received files remain available.
- [Close a sharing link after review is complete](https://help.dosya.dev/sharing/share-close-after-review): Preserve the activity evidence you need, revoke the correct sharing link, and verify its URL returns the permanent revoked state without deleting logs.
- [Complete named-recipient verification](https://help.dosya.dev/sharing/share-recipient-email-verification): Use the invited address, request a six-digit code, enter it within 15 minutes and five attempts, and recover without exposing recipient membership.
- [Confirm the first recipient access](https://help.dosya.dev/sharing/share-confirm-first-access): Confirm a first open from sharing analytics without mistaking a hashed visitor, recipient verification, or download row for named access proof.
- [Create a client file upload request](https://help.dosya.dev/sharing/file-request): Create a client upload request, choose its destination and limits, test the public page, and verify each received file in your workspace.
- [Create a secure file sharing link](https://help.dosya.dev/sharing/create-link): Create and test a cloud file sharing URL with the right recipient access, password, expiry, download controls and workspace policy.
- [Customize sharing-page branding](https://help.dosya.dev/sharing/custom-branding): Add a workspace logo, name, colour and permanent share handle, then control exactly which brand details recipients see on shared files and email.
- [Deliver several files as one share](https://help.dosya.dev/sharing/share-deliver-file-bundle): Create one link for 1–100 same-workspace files, apply recipient and download controls, then verify the complete public bundle before delivery.
- [Disable downloads on a sharing link](https://help.dosya.dev/sharing/share-disable-downloads): Replace an active sharing URL with a view-only link, confirm file and folder download controls are blocked, and send recipients the new address.
- [Download an allowed file from a share](https://help.dosya.dev/sharing/share-recipient-download-file): Complete required gates, use the exact Download control, and recognize view-only, download-cap, archive-size, and interrupted-transfer outcomes.
- [Edit file-request instructions](https://help.dosya.dev/sharing/request-edit-instructions): Edit a file request's title and uploader message across supported clients, understand permission rules, and confirm what changes for existing invitees.
- [Edit or close a file request](https://help.dosya.dev/sharing/manage-file-request): Change a file request’s instructions, password, deadline, destination or limits, then revoke it safely without losing files already received.
- [Email a share link with a message](https://help.dosya.dev/sharing/share-email-message): Email one Dosya share URL and a 500-character note to up to 50 people, then interpret web delivery details and mobile's simpler result message.
- [Enter a sharing-link password safely](https://help.dosya.dev/sharing/share-recipient-password): Enter the sender-provided password, recover from network and lockout errors, and understand the 30-minute browser grant and full-lock privacy behavior.
- [Export sharing analytics for review](https://help.dosya.dev/sharing/share-export-analytics-details): Review the available 7-, 30-, or 90-day analytics and capture the visible 25-event table while recognizing that web CSV export is unavailable.
- [Export sharing analytics safely](https://help.dosya.dev/sharing/export-analytics): Understand why per-link analytics cannot currently be exported, what the visible 25-row log contains, and which evidence can be recorded safely.
- [Extend or shorten a sharing-link expiry](https://help.dosya.dev/sharing/share-change-expiry): Edit an active or expired non-revoked link's deadline in the Dosya mobile app, keeping its URL while applying workspace and free-plan expiry caps.
- [Fix a rejected or incomplete file-request upload](https://help.dosya.dev/sharing/troubleshoot-file-request): Match the exact file-request error to its cause, recover an interrupted transfer and confirm whether Dosya received the file before retrying.
- [Inspect details for a share access event](https://help.dosya.dev/sharing/share-access-event): Read one access-log row's time, event, opaque visitor, country and device fields without mistaking anonymous telemetry for recipient identity.
- [Investigate unexpected sharing-link activity](https://help.dosya.dev/sharing/share-investigate-unexpected-activity): Preserve the newest event evidence, interpret anonymous visitor and country fields correctly, revoke the link, and verify access is contained.
- [Invite file-request uploaders and track submissions](https://help.dosya.dev/sharing/request-recipients): Send recipient-specific upload invitations, interpret Pending and Uploaded, resend safely, and understand forwarding, removal and delivery limits.
- [Match a recipient to sharing activity](https://help.dosya.dev/sharing/share-match-recipient-activity): Use recipient verification and the anonymous access log correctly, without assigning individual opens or downloads to a named person without evidence.
- [Open a Dosya sharing link for the first time](https://help.dosya.dev/sharing/share-recipient-open-link): Open the complete dosya.dev share URL, distinguish recipient and password gates from terminal link errors, and confirm the revealed item before acting.
- [Password protect a file request](https://help.dosya.dev/sharing/request-password): Add, replace or remove a file-request password and understand unlock attempts, browser grants, invited-recipient tracking and immediate shutdown.
- [Password protect a file sharing link](https://help.dosya.dev/sharing/password-link): Create and test a password-protected file, folder or bundle link, including private-recipient verification, unlock limits and workspace policy errors.
- [Preflight a sharing link in a private window](https://help.dosya.dev/sharing/share-preflight-private-window): Test a share without account or grant cookies, complete gates in server order, and verify expiry, identity, preview, and download behavior before delivery.
- [Preview workspace sharing branding](https://help.dosya.dev/sharing/preview-branding): Compare desktop and phone share pages, a locked recipient view, and the real email template before saving workspace branding for recipients.
- [Read sharing-link analytics](https://help.dosya.dev/sharing/analytics): Interpret first opens, downloads, visitor reach, recipient verification, and the newest 25 access events for one Dosya sharing link accurately.
- [Read sharing-link visitor counts](https://help.dosya.dev/sharing/share-read-visitors): Separate all-time hashed visitor reach from verified recipients and the 7-, 30-, or 90-day first-open chart when measuring a shared file's audience.
- [Reading link access and download activity](https://help.dosya.dev/sharing/link-activity): Use a sharing link's analytics to review first opens, downloads, devices, countries and recipient verification without overstating identity.
- [Recover a file-request invitation that was not received](https://help.dosya.dev/sharing/request-resend-invitation): Resend a pending file-request invitation, verify its Sent timestamp, and distinguish a delivered reminder from a mailbox or address problem.
- [Remove a recipient from a file request](https://help.dosya.dev/sharing/request-remove-recipient): Remove a file-request recipient safely, understand why the public link may still work, and preserve files that the address already uploaded.
- [Replace a rejected file-request item](https://help.dosya.dev/sharing/request-uploader-replace-rejected): Remove a preflight-rejected request item, stage a compliant replacement, and retry transfer failures without resending files already received.
- [Report a sharing-link access problem](https://help.dosya.dev/sharing/share-recipient-report-problem): Record the exact share-page state and safe context, contact the sender or Dosya, and use the prefilled abuse form without exposing passwords or codes.
- [Require named recipients for a sensitive share](https://help.dosya.dev/sharing/share-require-named-recipients): Create a private file share for named email addresses, enforce one-time-code verification, and confirm that a forwarded URL alone cannot grant access.
- [Resend a file-request invitation](https://help.dosya.dev/sharing/request-resend-invite): Resend one or all pending file-request invitations, verify delivery timestamps, and understand what the reminder changes for each recipient.
- [Review file download events for a share](https://help.dosya.dev/sharing/share-review-download-events): Filter the newest 25 access rows for downloads, compare the selected-range chart with Shared-list counts, and interpret anonymous evidence accurately.
- [Review files submitted to a request](https://help.dosya.dev/sharing/request-review-uploads): Review file-request uploads by name, size, uploader, and time across web and native clients, then handle unexpected files without losing evidence.
- [Revoke a sharing link after delivery](https://help.dosya.dev/sharing/share-revoke-after-delivery): Review a delivered link's access history, revoke it from Shared, and understand the permanent recipient cutoff plus the retained audit record afterward.
- [Revoking a sharing link](https://help.dosya.dev/sharing/revoke-link): Find a link in Shared, revoke it, and check that the old URL is no longer available to recipients.
- [Save a file-request submission receipt](https://help.dosya.dev/sharing/request-uploader-save-receipt): Save the on-page received stamp with file names, total bytes, local time, and request reference before changing browsers or losing visitor history.
- [Send an updated sharing link after changing settings](https://help.dosya.dev/sharing/share-send-updated-settings): Edit a live link in the Dosya mobile app, preserve its URL, retest changed access rules, and tell existing recipients exactly what now applies.
- [Setting file-request types, sizes, counts and expiry](https://help.dosya.dev/sharing/request-limits): Choose what a request accepts, where submissions land, when uploading stops and how uploader folders are organized.
- [Setting link expiry and checking the actual expiration](https://help.dosya.dev/sharing/link-expiry): Choose a preset or custom expiry, understand workspace and plan caps, and confirm when the finished sharing link will stop working.
- [Share a cloud folder with one link](https://help.dosya.dev/sharing/folder-link): Create and test one URL for a cloud folder, including dynamic subfolders, hidden or locked exclusions, view-only access and ZIP limits.
- [Share a Dosya file from your phone](https://help.dosya.dev/sharing/mobile-share): Create a protected Dosya link on iPhone or Android, confirm its live settings, then hand the URL to another app with the system share sheet.
- [Share several files with one link](https://help.dosya.dev/sharing/share-file-bundle): Select up to 100 files in one workspace, create one bundle URL on the web, and verify that its recipient page shows exactly the intended file set.
- [Sharing with named email recipients](https://help.dosya.dev/sharing/named-recipients): Send a private link to specific addresses, test the one-time-code gate, and understand what happens when someone forwards the URL.
- [Stage several files for a request](https://help.dosya.dev/sharing/request-uploader-stage-files): Stage files from picker, folder, drop, paste, photo library, or camera; inspect paths and rejections before starting the three-file upload queue.
- [Stop an uploader from using a file-request invitation](https://help.dosya.dev/sharing/request-remove-uploader): Stop future invitation email, understand what recipient removal changes, and revoke the request when the existing upload URL must stop working.
- [Track a failed file-request submission](https://help.dosya.dev/sharing/request-failed-submission): Diagnose rejected or interrupted file-request uploads from exact messages, then retry safely without resending files that were already received.
- [Troubleshoot an unavailable sharing link](https://help.dosya.dev/sharing/unavailable-link): Match the public sharing message to expiry, revocation, deletion, locks, recipient checks, passwords, download controls, regional rules or transfer allowances.
- [Upload files through a file request](https://help.dosya.dev/sharing/request-upload): Send files without a Dosya account, satisfy the request's extension, size and slot rules, recover interrupted transfers, and keep the delivery receipt.
- [Use a recipient verification code](https://help.dosya.dev/sharing/share-recipient-verification): Use a private share's six-digit email code, accounting for the email's 10-minute wording and the server's actual 15-minute acceptance window.
- [Verify a file-request invitation before uploading](https://help.dosya.dev/sharing/request-uploader-confirm-invite): Confirm the sender, workspace, recipient address, request rules and final receipt before releasing files through a client upload invitation.

## Cloud storage and file management

- [Add a comment to a Dosya file](https://help.dosya.dev/files/comments-add-file-comment): Add a file comment with a page or playback anchor, mentions, and clear review context; then confirm its author, timestamp, and recipient delivery state.
- [Add a file to Favourites](https://help.dosya.dev/files/favourite-file): Add a file shortcut to Favourites from Files, understand visibility and workspace rules, and recover when the star or favourite list does not update.
- [Add a folder to Favourites](https://help.dosya.dev/files/favourite-folder): Add a folder shortcut through Dosya's REST API, because current web and mobile clients expose file favourites but no folder-favourite control.
- [Add several files to a group](https://help.dosya.dev/files/batch-add-group): Add several files to one Dosya group through repeated single-item actions, with exact duplicate, access, confinement, and no-batch limits explained.
- [Add the Dosya backup widget on Android](https://help.dosya.dev/files/mobile-backup-widget-android): Add the Android home-screen backup widget and interpret its small and medium layouts, refresh timing, stale state, storage warning, and tap behavior.
- [Add the Dosya backup widget on iPhone](https://help.dosya.dev/files/mobile-backup-widget-ios): Add the iPhone backup widget, choose its supported size, read live and last-run facts, and understand refresh, theme, and Live Activity behavior.
- [Avoid duplicate contacts during restore](https://help.dosya.dev/files/mobile-contacts-restore-duplicates): Avoid accidental duplicate contact restores by checking the VCF and phone first, because Dosya currently adds every card without preview, merge, or dedupe.
- [Back up contacts from your phone](https://help.dosya.dev/files/contacts-backup): Export all readable phone contacts to a dated vCard, track the queued upload, and verify the cloud file instead of relying on the initial count.
- [Back up Live Photos and motion photos](https://help.dosya.dev/files/mobile-backup-live-media): Back up Live Photos and motion photos, distinguish pair detection from companion upload failure, and understand the current 25-item backfill limit.
- [Back up only one mobile contact account](https://help.dosya.dev/files/mobile-contacts-account-scope): Understand which contacts Dosya backs up on mobile, why there is no account selector, and how to verify the exported count before relying on the VCF.
- [Browse a deep folder tree](https://help.dosya.dev/files/browse-folder-tree): Navigate deep Files breadcrumbs and destination-picker trees, including lazy expansion, 250 ms search, 50-result cap, role scope, and confirmation.
- [Browse a Vault Space on mobile](https://help.dosya.dev/files/mobile-vault-browse-space): Find your own and shared Vault Spaces on mobile, open encrypted folders safely, and recover when a Space name, grant, or folder listing cannot load.
- [Browse an archive on mobile](https://help.dosya.dev/files/mobile-archive-browse): Browse ZIP, ISO, and IMG folders on Dosya mobile, preview images, transfer other entries, and save eligible files into cloud storage safely.
- [Browse backed-up files on mobile](https://help.dosya.dev/files/mobile-browse-files): Switch to the right workspace, browse or search cloud folders, load more results, and open a backed-up item without confusing its phone original.
- [Browse folders inside an archive](https://help.dosya.dev/files/archive-browse): Browse folders and filter entries inside ZIP, ISO, and IMG files without extraction; understand listing caps and truncated archive results in Dosya.
- [Browse your Dosya audio library in the car](https://help.dosya.dev/files/carplay-browse-library): Browse Dosya audio through Apple CarPlay using active-workspace folders, up to 20 recents, 100-item folder pages, depth limits, and phone recovery.
- [Change mobile backup settings](https://help.dosya.dev/files/mobile-backup-settings): Choose which phone media is backed up, when transfers may run, and which workspaces receive new copies without moving or replacing earlier uploads.
- [Check access before moving into a restricted folder](https://help.dosya.dev/files/file-move-restricted-destination): Resolve a blocked file move by checking upload permission, confinement, destination visibility, locks, backup protection, and name conflicts.
- [Check image dimensions in Dosya](https://help.dosya.dev/files/media-check-image-dimensions): Read image dimensions from the mobile viewer, distinguish decoded size from server metadata, and avoid treating a HEIC derivative as original pixels.
- [Check where a file came from](https://help.dosya.dev/files/file-origin-details): Read Origin, uploader, dates, region, import source, and account metadata correctly, including how copying changes the recorded creation event.
- [Choose albums for mobile backup](https://help.dosya.dev/files/mobile-backup-albums): Select Android folders or iPhone albums, understand partial-library access, and verify exactly which device media enters future backup scans.
- [Choose between a lock and a role restriction](https://help.dosya.dev/files/folder-choose-lock-or-restriction): Choose a folder password, view-only lock, workspace role, or assigned root by matching the control to who needs access and what they may do.
- [Choose repeat and shuffle modes](https://help.dosya.dev/files/audio-repeat-shuffle): Understand that web Shuffle queue and Repeat queue are currently inactive, then use working sequential queue and A-B loop controls without assumptions.
- [Choose whether to move or copy a file](https://help.dosya.dev/files/file-choose-move-or-copy): Choose Move when one file should change folders or Copy when a separate stored item is needed, with clear permission, quota, and identity checks.
- [Choose Wi-Fi or cellular backup](https://help.dosya.dev/files/mobile-backup-network): Control cellular, Wi-Fi, charging, and low-battery behavior, then use a one-run override without changing future automatic backup policy for later runs.
- [Clear a multi-file selection](https://help.dosya.dev/files/clear-file-selection): Clear every selected file and folder from the Files bulk bar, understand automatic selection resets, and avoid carrying stale items into an action.
- [Clear a selection after a batch action](https://help.dosya.dev/files/selection-clear-after-action): Clear web file and folder selections explicitly, know which completed batch actions clear them automatically, and prevent old IDs crossing view changes.
- [Clear a stale Vault device cache safely](https://help.dosya.dev/files/vault-clear-device-cache): Clear only local Vault state safely: finish transfers, use Lock, understand persisted Space hints, and avoid the irreversible destroy-vault control.
- [Clear filters that hide files](https://help.dosya.dev/files/clear-file-filters): Clear search text, sidebar filters, group views, and map date or folder filters so the intended Dosya file list becomes visible again on web.
- [Clear stale search filters](https://help.dosya.dev/files/search-clear-stale-filters): Clear the real web search constraints: reset the results tab, remove any ext token, clear the query, and distinguish global Search from Files filters.
- [Combine a folder scope with a file-type filter](https://help.dosya.dev/files/search-folder-and-type): Combine a live folder breadcrumb with the Files sidebar type view and local search, while understanding when Images, Videos, and Documents go global.
- [Commenting on a file and managing replies](https://help.dosya.dev/files/comments-and-replies): Open a file conversation, post and reply to feedback, and understand who can read, edit or delete each comment.
- [Compare entries in file version history](https://help.dosya.dev/files/version-compare-details): Compare version number, Latest state, exact timestamp, size, uploader, and previewed bytes before restoring; understand fields history does not show.
- [Compare preview metadata with File details](https://help.dosya.dev/files/media-compare-preview-details): Compare the preview with File details using filename, size, kind, and version while treating decoded dimensions or duration as viewer-only data.
- [Confirm a destination before moving a file](https://help.dosya.dev/files/file-move-confirm-destination): Confirm a file-move destination by workspace, folder tree, search result, and final listing before committing a location change with no automatic undo.
- [Confirm the active workspace on mobile](https://help.dosya.dev/files/mobile-file-confirm-workspace): Confirm the active mobile workspace, role, folder scope, storage, and backup destination before opening, sharing, moving, or uploading files.
- [Control which phone contacts Dosya backs up](https://help.dosya.dev/files/contacts-source): Understand the contact scope used by Dosya mobile backup, review the phone address book before export, and create a verified vCard copy in your active cloud workspace.
- [Copy a file to another folder](https://help.dosya.dev/files/copy-file): Copy a Dosya file into another folder, account for full duplicate storage, and resolve name, permission, lock, quota, or Live Photo failures.
- [Correct lyrics that do not match playback](https://help.dosya.dev/files/audio-troubleshoot-lyrics-timing): Fix lyric highlighting by validating accepted timestamp syntax, sorted cues, current playback time, and untimed fallback behavior in the browser player.
- [Correct your own file comment](https://help.dosya.dev/files/comments-correct-own-comment): Edit a comment you authored, preserve its original file anchor, update mentions safely, and verify the corrected text without duplicating the thread.
- [Create a folder in the right workspace](https://help.dosya.dev/files/create-folder): Create one folder or a nested path in the correct Dosya workspace, using exact name limits while avoiding locked, hidden, or confined locations.
- [Delete an accidental comment](https://help.dosya.dev/files/comments-delete-accidental-comment): Remove an accidental comment after verifying its file, author, and replies; understand the immediate cascade and the lack of comment recovery.
- [Delete and restore a cloud file on mobile](https://help.dosya.dev/files/mobile-delete-restore): Move a file to Trash in the Dosya mobile app, restore it safely, and understand when permanent deletion removes it from cloud storage.
- [Delete multiple items together](https://help.dosya.dev/files/batch-delete-files): Delete many Dosya files and folders safely, understand chunk limits, locked-item refusals and partial results, then verify each item in Deleted.
- [Delete selected duplicate copies](https://help.dosya.dev/files/duplicates-delete-selected): Select exact copies, keep the right cloud file, interpret Dosya's reclaimable total, and move only permitted duplicates into recoverable workspace trash.

## Account and security

- [Apply a promotion or coupon](https://help.dosya.dev/account/billing-apply-coupon): Validate a Promo code against the selected billing interval and available seats, then verify its duration, Discount row and final total before purchase.

- [Upgrade a plan or add storage](https://help.dosya.dev/account/upgrade-storage): Choose a plan or 100 GB, 1 TB, or 5 TB storage add-ons, review live pricing, and verify the resulting account capacity after Stripe settles.
- [Verify a plan or storage change after checkout](https://help.dosya.dev/account/verify-plan-change): Verify a completed plan or storage purchase safely across the success page, receipt and Billing ledger without creating a duplicate checkout.
- [Verify an email before signing in](https://help.dosya.dev/account/signin-complete-email-verification): Complete Dosya email verification with the newest six-digit code, understand expiry and attempt limits, and recover when delivery fails safely.
- [Verify email notification delivery](https://help.dosya.dev/account/notifications-verify-email-delivery): Check Dosya's Email channel, event rules, inbox placement, and mandatory notices to distinguish an opt-out from a delivery failure or provider delay.
- [Verify storage after an upgrade](https://help.dosya.dev/account/plan-verify-storage-upgrade): Confirm an upgrade through the success state, storage ledger, total limit, subscription interval and Stripe receipt before retrying uploads.
- [Verify that a revoked session is closed](https://help.dosya.dev/account/sessions-verify-revoked-device): Confirm a revoked Dosya browser or mobile credential disappears, fails its next authenticated request, and requires a fresh sign-in on every device.

## API keys and integrations

- [Acknowledge a webhook delivery promptly](https://help.dosya.dev/developers/webhook-acknowledge-promptly): Verify a Dosya webhook signature over the raw body, store the event durably, and return a 2xx response before the ten-second delivery timeout.

- [Choose a Dosya MCP client configuration](https://help.dosya.dev/developers/mcp-choose-client-config): Choose a remote OAuth-capable MCP client, add Dosya’s connector URL, approve one workspace, and verify read-only file tools without API keys.
- [Choose read, upload or full API-key permission](https://help.dosya.dev/developers/api-key-scopes): Choose Read only, Upload only, or Full access from the operation the client needs, then prove both an allowed request and a denied boundary.
- [Choose webhook event subscriptions](https://help.dosya.dev/developers/webhook-events): Choose file upload, file deletion, or share access events, understand each payload, and test the exact changes your receiver must process.
- [Cloud storage REST API quickstart](https://help.dosya.dev/developers/rest-api-quickstart): Create a read-only REST key, list workspaces and files with curl, and diagnose authentication, access and retry responses without changing stored data.
- [Complete and verify an API upload](https://help.dosya.dev/developers/api-complete-upload-session): Upload every multipart segment, complete the session once, recover a lost response through status, and confirm the returned file record safely.
- [Connect an MCP client to Dosya](https://help.dosya.dev/developers/mcp-connect): Connect an OAuth-capable MCP client to Dosya, authorize one workspace and verify its read-only tools. Includes scopes, limits, token timing and disconnection.
- [Connect MCP with a restricted credential](https://help.dosya.dev/developers/mcp-connect-restricted-credential): Connect an AI client through Dosya OAuth, pin it to one readable workspace, limit optional account data, and verify the granted read boundary.
- [Create a full-access API key safely](https://help.dosya.dev/developers/api-key-full-access): Create a Full access key with explicit reach, protocol, origin, usage, and expiry guards, then prove its required mutation and configured boundary.
- [Create a read-only Dosya API key](https://help.dosya.dev/developers/api-key-read-only): Create a Read only key for listing and downloads, apply compatible reach controls, and prove that an attempted folder creation is refused by scope.
- [Create a REST API upload session](https://help.dosya.dev/developers/api-create-upload-session): Start a REST API upload with the correct destination, size, scope, and multipart settings, then inspect the returned session before sending bytes.
- [Create a webhook endpoint](https://help.dosya.dev/developers/webhook-create): Register a workspace webhook through the app or REST, verify signed events, test delivery and handle retries, endpoint caps, secret rotation and deletion.

- [Create an upload-only Dosya API key](https://help.dosya.dev/developers/api-key-upload-only): Create an Upload only REST key, start and finish a file transfer without list access, and verify the result through the response or another trusted view.
- [Create and move folders with the REST API](https://help.dosya.dev/developers/api-folder-operations): Create, rename, and move folders through their exact REST endpoints, then verify the final parent while preserving names and avoiding tree conflicts.
- [Creating and managing an API key](https://help.dosya.dev/developers/api-key): Generate a key in Profile, choose its permissions and restrictions, save it while it is displayed, and replace or revoke it later.
- [Deduplicate webhook deliveries](https://help.dosya.dev/developers/webhook-deduplicate-deliveries): Use the Dosya event ID as a transactional idempotency key so automatic retries and manual redelivery cannot repeat downstream side effects safely.
- [Delete an unused webhook endpoint](https://help.dosya.dev/developers/webhook-delete-endpoint): Export any required delivery evidence, delete the selected webhook endpoint, and understand that its history and pending retries are removed permanently.
- [Disconnect MCP and rotate its credential](https://help.dosya.dev/developers/mcp-disconnect-rotate-credential): Revoke an MCP OAuth grant from Connected AI apps, allow its brief validation-cache window to close, then reconnect with a fresh grant safely.
- [Distinguish unavailable and unauthorized API files](https://help.dosya.dev/developers/api-file-not-found-vs-forbidden): Interpret file 404 and 403 responses without probing unrelated identifiers, leaking a hidden resource, or mistaking a permissions failure for deletion.
- [Download a file with the REST API](https://help.dosya.dev/developers/api-download-file): Obtain a signed REST download URL, choose its lifetime or file version, fetch and verify bytes, and resolve locks, permissions and usage failures.

## Desktop app

- [Adjust desktop transfer concurrency](https://help.dosya.dev/desktop/desktop-transfer-concurrency): Set desktop sync concurrency and bandwidth limits, understand the real worker counts, and verify throughput without overloading your computer.
- [Browse an archive in the desktop app](https://help.dosya.dev/desktop/desktop-archive-viewer): Browse ZIP, ISO, and IMG contents without extracting the complete archive, preview supported entries, and save folders of up to 500 files into Dosya.

- [Check for desktop app updates](https://help.dosya.dev/desktop/desktop-check-updates): Check a direct-download desktop build for updates, follow each download state, and install safely across Windows, macOS, and Linux without losing work.
- [Check storage before starting desktop sync](https://help.dosya.dev/desktop/desktop-sync-check-storage): Check cloud capacity, large-folder count warnings, and the desktop download guard before starting a storage-intensive sync pair with fewer surprises.
- [Choose a desktop sync mode for a folder](https://help.dosya.dev/desktop/desktop-sync-plan-mode): Choose among Dosya’s five desktop sync modes by deciding which side may change, which deletions propagate, and how Full Sync resolves conflicts.
- [Choose the correct desktop update path](https://help.dosya.dev/desktop/desktop-choose-update-path): Match the installed Dosya desktop channel to its direct, Microsoft Store, Mac App Store, Snap, or Linux AppImage update procedure without mixing sources.

- [Fix an S3 signature time error](https://help.dosya.dev/integrations/s3-fix-signature-time-error): Diagnose S3 signature mismatch versus presigned expiry, inspect the signing machine’s clock and retry a newly signed read-only Dosya request.
- [Fix an unknown-size remote download](https://help.dosya.dev/integrations/remote-download-unknown-size): Choose a source that reports a positive Content-Length or total Content-Range, or download locally when Dosya cannot reserve an unknown byte count.
- [Fix remote-download quota or locked-destination errors](https://help.dosya.dev/integrations/remote-download-quota-locked): Resolve storage-cap and locked-backup destination failures, account for the completion-time quota check, and retry safely into a writable folder.

- [Handle a failed Dosya node in n8n](https://help.dosya.dev/integrations/n8n-handle-dosya-node-error): Interpret Dosya node status text, bounded retries, Continue On Fail output and plan or permission refusals before replaying a workflow item.

## Troubleshooting

- [Contacting support with useful information](https://help.dosya.dev/troubleshooting/contact-support): Open a private support ticket with reproducible steps, safe diagnostics and redacted screenshots so the team can investigate without receiving account secrets.
- [Fix paused mobile background backup](https://help.dosya.dev/troubleshooting/mobile-background-backup): Restore Dosya photo backup after permission, network, power, workspace, storage, manual-stop, or operating-system scheduling interruptions.
- [Fixing a slow upload or download](https://help.dosya.dev/troubleshooting/slow-transfer): Compare a small transfer, check status and queue state, reduce competing work, and separate network delay from policy or storage failures.
- [How to check that a Dosya change worked](https://help.dosya.dev/troubleshooting/verify-change-worked): Confirm a Dosya change by refreshing the relevant view, checking the exact saved state and testing one harmless item before repeating the action.
- [Share diagnostics with Dosya support safely](https://help.dosya.dev/troubleshooting/support-privacy): Prepare reproducible steps, timestamps, client details, IDs, redacted logs, and screenshots without exposing credentials, private links, or file content.
- [Troubleshoot a cloud import](https://help.dosya.dev/troubleshooting/cloud-imports): Isolate a cloud import failure with one supported item, the exact destination and job receipt, then handle reconnect, quota or partial completion safely.
- [Troubleshoot a Dosya MCP connection](https://help.dosya.dev/troubleshooting/mcp): Separate MCP transport, OAuth, scope, workspace visibility, rate-limit, and file-conversion failures, then verify with a read-only tool call.
- [Troubleshoot a Dosya SFTP connection or transfer](https://help.dosya.dev/troubleshooting/sftp): Resolve SFTP host-key, password, key restriction, role, path, upload-close, size, quota, throttling, and interrupted-transfer failures.
- [Troubleshoot a Dosya Zapier automation](https://help.dosya.dev/troubleshooting/zapier): Trace a failed Zap through invitation, account connection, key restrictions, trigger subscription, sample data, field mapping, upload, and replay.
- [Troubleshoot a failed payment or unexpected bill](https://help.dosya.dev/troubleshooting/billing): Reconcile the subscription, storage ledger, next invoice and payment state before retrying checkout or reporting an unexpected private charge.
- [Troubleshoot a missing referral reward](https://help.dosya.dev/troubleshooting/referral-rewards): Trace a missing referral reward through the public status, seven-day and 50 MiB qualification rules, daily settlement and the 25 GB reward cap.
- [Troubleshoot a Vault that will not unlock](https://help.dosya.dev/troubleshooting/vault-unlock): Diagnose encryption-status, passphrase and recovery-key failures without exposing secrets or destroying an encrypted Vault by mistake.
- [Troubleshoot Dosya CLI authentication and transfers](https://help.dosya.dev/troubleshooting/cli): Use CLI exit codes and debug output to isolate installation, API base, credentials, workspace, permission, timeout, quota, and upload errors.
- [Troubleshoot Dosya S3 authentication and access](https://help.dosya.dev/troubleshooting/s3): Use the S3 error code to repair credentials, SigV4 settings, workspace pinning, permissions, file limits, quota, or request throttling.
- [Troubleshoot failed Dosya webhook deliveries](https://help.dosya.dev/troubleshooting/webhooks): Diagnose webhook reachability, signatures, timeouts, HTTP responses, retries, auto-disablement, duplicates, redelivery, and secret rotation.
- [Troubleshoot missing Dosya notifications](https://help.dosya.dev/troubleshooting/notifications): Trace a missing Dosya alert through event eligibility, group and channel settings, browser permission, email delivery, and the in-app inbox.
- [Troubleshooting a failed upload](https://help.dosya.dev/troubleshooting/failed-upload): Read a failed upload’s message, retry while the original file is available, or use Resume after a reload and verify the completed copy.
- [What to include in a Dosya support request](https://help.dosya.dev/troubleshooting/contact-support-safely): Prepare a Dosya support request with the exact time, steps and redacted evidence while keeping passwords, recovery codes and API keys private.
